rationale: The image shows a complete exterior view of the building mass from the front, so it is usable as a massing reference. The overall form is legible as low, horizontal, rectilinear volumes with minor offsets and a recessed entry. It is not an interior, detail, or obscured view, and it reveals enough three-dimensional mass to read basic operations like setback and attachment, though the facade treatment is more prominent than the volumetric transformation.
